task.title: Inputting the decision on a blocked claim

step.cmd: Reinstate the collection of the debt by referring to Reinstating the collection of a debt .
Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 4.
If all rows are blank, go to step 6.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a Claim Review (CR) WI for the issue:

ul.li: If no, hold the task for 24 hours.

If yes, move the WI to Pending as follows:
Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, repeat step 4.
If all rows are blank, go to step 6.

step.cmd: Review the Summary tab, then select the Allocations link and determine if there is a W allocation on file:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 7.
If no, go to step 8.

step.cmd: On the Allocations tab, in the Allocations section, input the allocation as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Detection: Select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if an FWW code must be removed for any of the claimant’s reports under review and applied to an OP that will be created:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 9.
If no, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In BCS, on the Allocation “A” tab, in the Amended Earnings and FWW columns, modify the week of the FWW as follows:

ul.li:
Select the week that requires a change. Repeat for every week that requires a change.
Amended earnings: remove the earnings.
FWW: Select the new FWW code.
Detection: Select 97 - EI ERB – Compliance .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine which of the following situations applies:

ul.li: If a D47 must be modified, go to step 11.
If a D47 must be rescinded, go to step 18.

step.cmd: Determine if the start and end dates of the disentitlements must be modified:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 12.
If only the end dates must be modified, go to step 23.

step.cmd: On day one, on the Disentitlements tab, in the Disentitlements section, input up to 4 disentitlements as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period .
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date, if necessary.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction and determine if it is correct:

ul.li: If no, go to step 14.
If yes, select Close and go to step 15.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Select Close .
Return to step 12.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Correct disentitlement input — original disentitlement will be rescinded on day 2.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in BCS, determine if the Results tab shows an error code:

ul.li: If yes go to step 17.
If no, go to step 18.

step.cmd: In WECS , review the error code displayed to determine if IPOC action is required:

ul.li: If WECS indicates IPOC action is required, go to step 28.
If WECS indicates a corrective action, correct the transaction and return to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, do the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To clear the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, in the Disentitlements section, rescind up to 4 disentitlements as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select X - Rescind .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period.
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction and determine if it is correct:

ul.li: If no, go to step 21.
If yes, select Close and go to step 26.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Select Close .
Return to step 19.

step.cmd: Select the BPC to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, do the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To clear the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, in the Disentitlements section, modify up to 4 disentitlements as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select T - Terminate .
Type: Select 47 - EI ERB - Earnings limit exceeded for the four week period.
Start date: Enter the disentitlement start date.
End date: Enter the disentitlement end date.
Detection: Select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction and determine if it is correct:

ul.li: If no, go to step 25.
If yes, select Close and go to step 26.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Select Close .
Return to step 23.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in BCS, determine if the Results tab shows an error code:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 27.
If no, go to step 32.

step.cmd: In WECS , review the error code displayed and determine if IPOC action is required:

ul.li: If WECS indicates IPOC action is required, go to step 28.
If WECS indicates a corrective action, correct the transaction and return to step 23.

step.cmd: In BCS, on the Results tab, select the estimated result that must be sent to IPOC and select the Forward via MM06 link.
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Detection: Select 21 - Request for Reconsideration / ≤ w/c 1867 appeal .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 45 - You are not entitled to EI Emergency Response Benefits, this caused an overpayment .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentative .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave this field blank.

Remarks lines 2–4: Type the appropriate details:
Add any missing information, if necessary.
Type “Terminate appeal lock on [DD-MM-YYYY].”
Type “Error code [XXX].
Type “ Apply UP to OP.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, send the X-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Insert ADMS Record ID (4059)
Notice of Administrative Review Decision addressed to client - Client Requested Reconsideration (11980)
Date Request for Reconsideration received (4063)
Date of Commission’s decision (4065): Select the date on the initial decision letter.
List of issues (11981)

Decision completely rescinded or removed / maintained / modified or replaced by a new decision (11982): Select the appropriate option:
Decision completely rescinded or removed
Decision modified or replaced by a new decision
Blank / When employer is an interested party (11984)

step.cmd: Determine if the initial decision was rescinded, modified or maintained:

ul.li: If the decision was rescinded, go to step 34.
If the decision was maintained, go to step 35.
If the decision was modified, go to step 36.

step.cmd: In ADMS, complete the Review Decision screen as follows:

ul.li: Date RFR Decision issued: Enter the date the reconsideration under EIA 112 was finalized. EIA 112
RFR Decision Result: Select Decision Rescinded .
Reason: Select the appropriate reason.
Date RFR Decision implemented: Enter the date the decision was implemented.
Date RFR Decision sent to Requestor: Enter the date the letter was sent.
Select Save .
Go to step 37.

step.cmd: In ADMS, complete the Review Decision screen as follows:

ul.li: Date RFR Decision issued: Enter the date the reconsideration under EIA 112 was finalized. EIA 112
RFR Decision Result: Select Decision Maintained .
Date RFR Decision implemented: Enter the date the decision was implemented.
Date RFR Decision sent to Requestor: Enter the date the letter was sent.
Select Save .
Go to step 37.

step.cmd: In ADMS, complete the Review Decision screen as follows:

ul.li: Date RFR Decision issued: Enter the date the reconsideration under EIA 112 was finalized. EIA 112
RFR Decision Result: Select Decision Maintained with Modifications .
Date RFR Decision implemented: Enter the date the decision was implemented.
Date RFR Decision sent to Requestor: Enter the date the letter was sent.
Select Save .

step.cmd: Determine if ADMS inputs are complete for all decisions:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 38.
If no, complete the missing fields. Go to step 38.

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI.
